title: A Cipher for the Protocol
author: Cyrus Thornbury
blurb: Jude Amberdale, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
